features: fair skin, close-cropped light hair, light eyes, broad open face, heavy jaw, clipped moustache, solid stocky build, wry half-smile, soft leather helmet with large round goggles pushed up on the brow, white linen overalls
bio: Followed his brother across the Atlantic four years later with less patience and more speed. Talked his way into the Sunbeam camp at Tours by rebuilding a seized magneto in an afternoon, and kept the seat by out-driving men with twice his years. The green cars suit him: light, quick, and happiest being thrown at a corner harder than the tyres agree with.
